question: Which of the following calculations is correct?
solution: \(\sqrt{8}-\sqrt{2}=2\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{2}=\sqrt{2}\); \(\sqrt{2}\) and \(\sqrt{3}\) are not like radicals and cannot be combined; \(3\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{2}=2\sqrt{2}\); \(\sqrt{12}+\sqrt{3}=2\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{3}=3\sqrt{3}\).
